You are assembling a clinical visit note. The sentences of one note are listed below in random order with their section headings removed. File every sentence under one of these four headings: SUBJECTIVE, OBJECTIVE EXAM, OBJECTIVE RESULTS, ASSESSMENT AND PLAN. In the JSON, the headings are the keys subjective, objective_exam, objective_results and assessment_and_plan. Return each sentence ID under exactly one heading. Do not leave any sentence out and do not invent IDs.

<sentences>
S1: The patient is a diabetic.
S2: A prescription for clindamycin 400 mg 2 times per day for 7 days will be provided as he does seem to have an infection.
S3: He has been advised to call the office if his symptoms worsen and we will get him in sooner, however, if he starts to develop a fever or necrosis he has been instructed to go to the ER.
S4: Patient reports history of diabetes.
S5: He reports the ulcer has recently become red and is draining.
S6: The patient will follow up with me in 2 weeks to assess his progress and for possible repeat debridement.
S7: Musculoskeletal: Reports right foot pain.
S8: 3 views of the right foot were taken.
S9: Right diabetic foot ulcer.
S10: He is taking medication for this, however, he does not monitor his blood sugar consistently.
S11: I have explained to him that his x-rays did not reveal any evidence of osteomyelitis.
S12: He will also be placed in a surgical shoe to provide increased support for the next month.
S13: Skin: Reports right foot ulcer with redness and drainage.
S14: There is some redness and drainage present as well as edema.
S15: Nontender to palpation.
S16: No necrosis, odor, or bony exposure.
S17: These reveal no evidence of osteomyelitis.
S18: He has seen his primary care physician and was prescribed antibiotics, however, he has not started them yet and does not recall the name of the medication.
S19: After reviewing the patient's examination and radiographic findings today, I have had a lengthy discussion with the patient in regards to his current symptoms.
S20: Gregory Hernandez is a pleasant 40-year-old male who presents to the clinic today for the evaluation of a non-healing right foot ulcer.
S21: MSK: Examination of the right foot: There is a 1 x 2 inch circular wound on the dorsal aspect laterally just proximal to the 5th MTP joint.
S22: Onset of ulcer was approximately 2 months ago after walking barefoot on the beach.
S23: At times he will also experience throbbing pain.
S24: I have recommended that we obtain an ankle brachial index to determine the blood supply in his foot.
S25: Debridement will be performed.
S26: His last A1C was around 10.
</sentences>

Return only the JSON object with the four keys.
